description: This file defines a server-side code-behind class for the AdminPanel page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application, handling various button click events to navigate to different pages within the Online Examination System.

classes.name: AdminPanel
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the AdminPanel web form, handling page load and navigation button clicks.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler invoked when the page loads. Currently empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'Home' button click. Currently empty.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click on the profile button to transfer control to 'AdminQueue.aspx'.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click on the leaderboard button to transfer control to 'AdminLeaderboard.aspx'.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click to set a new exam, transferring to 'SetExam.aspx'.

methods.name: eExamB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click to edit an existing exam, transferring to 'EditExam.aspx'.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the logout button click, transferring to 'LoginPage.aspx'.
